products: full-service operating leases for freight and tank railcars
segments.description: Provides railcar leasing, fleet maintenance, and management services to industrial shippers, railroads, and third-party investors in North America.
segments.evidence: Our Railcar Leasing and Services Group ("Leasing Group") is a leading provider in North America of comprehensive railcar industry services.

revenueModel.text: Industrial shippers and railroads pay fixed monthly lease rentals under leases of one to ten years, while railroads, leasing companies, and industrial shippers pay for manufactured railcars and services.
revenueModel.evidence: The terms of our railcar leases generally provide for fixed monthly rentals that vary from one year to ten years.
